properties.name: app.admin.username
properties.description: Username for the seeded admin account. Set via ADMIN_USERNAME environment variable.

properties.name: app.admin.password
properties.description: Password for the seeded admin account. Set via ADMIN_PASSWORD environment variable.

properties.name: app.jwt.secret
properties.description: Secret key used to sign JWT tokens (minimum 256 bits). Set via JWT_SECRET environment variable.

properties.name: app.jwt.expiration
properties.description: JWT token expiration time in milliseconds. Defaults to 86400000 (24 hours).

properties.name: app.cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Comma-separated list of allowed CORS origins. Set via CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS environment variable.

properties.name: app.upload.dir
properties.description: Directory path for uploaded files. Set via UPLOAD_DIR environment variable.

properties.name: app.restaurant.email
properties.description: Restaurant email address that receives contact form submissions. Set via RESTAURANT_EMAIL environment variable.
